full_details: Before you left, the part had the Duke's name at the head and no speech copied under it. After the play Bryan said the court had been at Whitehall since Saturday, with a tilt, a tourney, and tonight a masque of Proteus and a rock of adamant. Nobody was asked. Kemp set the scholars' nothing against a penny. Bryan had waited at Somerset House: the warrant for December's twenty pounds is drawn and moving, and my lord's word is to stop cleanly tomorrow and hand the Mayor no stick. At home Mistress Ansell asked which queen. You gave her no ruff, no plot, and no coin.
one_sentence: You played the Duke at two and, after the play, heard of the Whitehall masque and of a warrant that is moving.
title: Played the Duke and heard of the masque
